UPDATE task_groups
             SET name = $3,
                 show_rule = $4,
                 show_start_date = $5::text::date,
                 show_window_start = $6::text::time,
                 show_window_end = $7::text::time,
                 uncheck_rule = $8,
                 uncheck_start_date = $9::text::date,
                 uncheck_time = $10::text::time,
                 updated_at = now()
             WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2
